about_the_game:
Pegshot: Vendetta is a pachinko strategy game that combines elements of peggle, roguelite, and turn-based combat.

Bullets Fly, Gangsters Down!

In every adventure, you’ll acquire a variety of powerful bullets and equipments, each with unique abilities that can impact battles in unexpected approaches. Fire your shots, and the more pins you hit, the greater the damage dealt to your foes!

Various Styles, Endless Thrills!

With over hundreds of different bullets and equipment, and more to come in future updates, every run features randomly generated paths and enemies, making each adventure a fresh new experience.

Revenge...... or Redemption?

Among the gang, some foes are exceptionally formidable - watch out for them, and some of them seem have old scores to settle with you. As you progress through the ride, any deeper schemes hidden beneath it all?
